claim: The bug was in the live-feed merge logic in fetchLatest in TransferDesk.jsx
The static Curated view seed data was already clean and not the source of the bug
The original merge matched incoming feed records to existing ones purely by id
The original merge rebuilt its base from the hardcoded SEED_TRANSFERS snapshot on every poll
The original merge code was: const map = new Map(SEED_TRANSFERS.map((t) => [t.id, t])); data.transfers.forEach((t) => map.set(t.id, t));
The backend classifies each new tweet/article independently
A transfer progressing from talks to done is very likely to arrive under a new id rather than the original one
The old talks record for a player was never evicted and kept getting re-added from SEED_TRANSFERS on every 5-minute poll
The new done record was added alongside the old talks record
The bug caused the same real-world transfer to render in both the In Talks and Done & Confirmed columns simultaneously
The poll interval is every 5 minutes
A simulation was run reproducing the bug with Anthony Gordon reclassified as done under a new id
Under the old code, the simulation showed ['talks', 'done'] for Anthony Gordon simultaneously
Under the fixed code, the simulation showed only ['done'] for Anthony Gordon
The fix merges on a stable identity using kind + player instead of the raw feed id
The fix merges into the current state instead of resetting from the seed each time
The fixed merge code defines transferKey as (t) => (t.kind + '|' + t.player).toLowerCase()
The fixed merge code uses setTransfers with a prev-based updater function
The fixed merge code falls back to SEED_TRANSFERS when prev.length is 0
There was a secondary regression where live updates were silently reverted every poll because the merge always started over from the static seed
The fix also resolves the secondary regression of live updates being reverted on every poll
TransferDesk.jsx was modified
The file still builds after the fix
The file renders identically for the default curated view after the fix
REFRESH_CONFIG.endpoint is empty in the default curated view configuration
The fix only has effect once a live backend is wired up
